metadata.author: Adam Grimes
metadata.creator: calibre 3.42.0 [https://calibre-ebook.com]

audit_method.text: PyMuPDF text extraction in PDF page order for every page.
audit_method.visual: Every rendered page included in 12 contact sheets (20 pages per sheet, final sheet 14) and visually inspected; detailed visual-elements review applied to pages with figures/tables/drawings/images or sparse rendering.
audit_method.scope_note: Coverage confirms pages in this supplied file, not that the file contains every chapter listed in its table of contents.

content_completeness_warning: The table of contents lists Chapters 1-12, but this PDF moves from Part I material (through PDF p.85) to Part/Chapter 11 at PDF p.89. Chapters 3-10 are not present as readable chapter bodies in the supplied file. This audit cannot attribute their contents to the source.
